text: Dev-only flag to skip server TLS cert validation (forced off in release)

relates: T-38 — that ticket proposes a networkSecurityConfig trusting
user-installed CAs (works in release; the "proper" self-host path) plus a
distinct SSLException error message. This ticket is the quicker debug-only
trust-all bypass. Complementary, not duplicate — coordinate so the two
cert-handling paths and their settings/error surfaces don't collide.
